main_idea: GRPO raised Qwen3.8-27B's DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO training raised DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points
Base model scored 27.8% versus 39.1% after GRPO
Training data spans 500 tasks from 422 repositories
Reward rose from 0.570 to 0.856 over 15 updates
Training tasks are mostly feature requests
Entropy stayed stable with no sustained decline
summary: Clutter comes from the training diagnostics, dataset stats, task-type chart, and a repeated restatement of the gain; the graphic lacks nothing essential to read the 27.8% to 39.1% result.
